## Change
Describe the user-visible behavior and why it changed.

## Feature parity
- [ ] Shared policy lives in Core/Application, or the platform-specific reason is documented.
- [ ] Desktop integration is complete and checked.
- [ ] PWA integration is complete and checked.
- [ ] Any backend contract change remains compatible with installed PWA versions.
- [ ] Provider credentials and signed URLs stay out of logs, caches, screenshots, and fixtures.
- [ ] Relevant automated checks pass; required real-iPhone checks are listed explicitly.

## Validation
Record tests and any hardware-dependent checks still needed.
